items.title: Official Trump team moves $26M TRUMP to BitGo: Profit-taking or strategic exit?
items.whyYouShouldCare: The Trump team's $26M transfer to BitGo could indicate a shift in liquidity strategies, impacting market confidence and SOL's positioning.

items.title: Japan-listed Remixpoint sells all ETH, SOL, XRP and DOGE holdings in shift to bitcoin-only crypto strategy
items.whyYouShouldCare: Remixpoint's complete divestment from SOL in favor of a bitcoin-only strategy highlights potential shifts in institutional sentiment towards Solana's long-term viability.

items.title: Solana, ether, xrp lead majors slide as Iran strikes drive a broad risk selloff
items.whyYouShouldCare: The decline of Solana alongside other major cryptocurrencies amid geopolitical tensions suggests increased volatility and risk sensitivity within the ecosystem.
